FAQ

Clear answers before you choose a platform.

A practical overview of how Flurzi is structured, what each product does and where legal, financial and data responsibilities sit.

Flurzi
What is Flurzi?

Flurzi Mobile App Limited is a UK technology company building focused digital products for compliance, commitments, streaming and story reading.

Are the Flurzi platforms the same product?

No. SponsorSafe HR, Flurzi Commit, FlurziCinema and End Novel are separate products under the Flurzi company.

Is Flurzi only for the UK?

The company is UK-based. SponsorSafe HR is specifically designed around UK sponsor licence and right to work workflows; the other platforms have broader consumer use cases.

Brand Meaning
What does FLURZI stand for?

FLURZI stands for Future-focused Lifestyle Unification & Revolutionary Zenith of Innovation.

What does MOBILE APP LIMITED stand for?

MOBILE means Modern Omnichannel Business & Intelligent Lifestyle Ecosystems. APP means Advanced Platforms & Protocols. LIMITED means Leading Innovation, Mobility, Intelligence, & Technology for Evolving Digitalisation.

What is the complete company meaning?

Flurzi Mobile App Limited represents a visionary technology ecosystem engineered to shape the future of digital living through intelligent platforms, scalable systems and globally adaptive innovation.

What is the legacy statement?

"FLURZI MOBILE APP LIMITED exists to engineer intelligent digital ecosystems that redefine the relationship between technology, lifestyle, business and human advancement."

SponsorSafe HR
Who is SponsorSafe HR for?

It is for UK employers, HR teams, compliance officers and leadership teams managing sponsor licence duties and sponsored worker records.

Does SponsorSafe HR replace legal advice?

No. It is a software and workflow product. It can support compliance operations, but it does not replace legal or immigration advice from a qualified professional.

What can SponsorSafe HR help track?

The product direction covers sponsor licence management, right to work evidence, document expiry, reportable events, audit-ready exports, evidence packs and compliance visibility.

Flurzi Commit
What is Flurzi Commit?

Flurzi Commit is a secure membership platform for fixed-term commitment plans with plan setup, billing management, account controls, maturity progress and payout tracking.

Is Flurzi Commit financial advice?

No. It is a behavioural finance and goal-tracking product. It does not provide regulated financial, investment, tax or debt advice.

Can I use it for any saving goal?

The product is designed for defined financial targets where a user wants structure, visibility and a clear commitment period.

FlurziCinema
What is FlurziCinema?

FlurziCinema is a streaming platform for movies, series, reels and live entertainment with discovery and continue-watching features.

Is FlurziCinema the same as Flurzi Commit?

No. It is a separate entertainment product in the Flurzi family.

End Novel
What is End Novel?

End Novel is a free story-reading platform where readers can discover stories, save a library, follow rankings and unlock supported episodes.

What does EndNovel mean?

EndNovel means endless stories, reflecting a reading platform built around continuous discovery and story worlds readers can keep returning to.

Is End Novel only for paid reading?

No. The captured product positioning is free reading supported by ad unlocks.

Data and Accounts
How does Flurzi treat data protection?

Flurzi is designed around UK GDPR principles including purpose limitation, access control, secure storage and user rights such as access, correction and deletion.

Will there be paid plans?

The website can support free trials, paid subscriptions and enterprise demos. Final pricing terms should be confirmed before launch.

How do I contact the team?

Use the contact page or email hello@flurzimobileapp.co.uk for product, demo, support or privacy enquiries.

FLURZI

Building focused digital products for work, commitments, entertainment and reading.
